# spatially connects to

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:spatiallyConnectsTo`](gmeow-spatiallyConnectsTo.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/spatiallyConnectsTo>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a location to another location it is spatially or topologically traversable to — a road segment, a network link, a portal, or a transit stop connection. Symmetric: the link can be traversed in either direction. A specialization of the universal [`gmeow:connectsTo`](gmeow-connectsTo.md) spine. Distinct from [`gmeow:adjacentTo`](gmeow-adjacentTo.md) (RCC-8 EC: touching but not necessarily traversable) and from [`gmeow:containedInLocation`](gmeow-containedInLocation.md) (mereological containment).

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:spatiallyConnectsTo`](gmeow-spatiallyConnectsTo.md) from [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md) to [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:connectsTo`](gmeow-connectsTo.md), [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for locations that are traversable to one another — a road segment, network link, portal, or transit connection; symmetric, a specialization of [`gmeow:connectsTo`](gmeow-connectsTo.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for mere touching without traversability ([`gmeow:adjacentTo`](gmeow-adjacentTo.md) / RCC-8 EC) and for containment ([`gmeow:containedInLocation`](gmeow-containedInLocation.md)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:spatiallyConnectsTo`](gmeow-spatiallyConnectsTo.md) between Locations; it carries traversability, distinct from adjacency and containment.

### Examples

- ex:stationA [`gmeow:spatiallyConnectsTo`](gmeow-spatiallyConnectsTo.md) ex:stationB.
